comment: Communities/districts along the Airport→Kingston→Bog Walk→Ocho Rios route. Each entry triggers a recognition-layer-2 community sign as the player enters. Entries marked needs_owner_review require the owner's lived knowledge to confirm exact placement and note.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The iconic narrow peninsula — sea on both sides of the road.

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Where the Palisadoes meets Windward Road.

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Home of the Rockfort Mineral Bath.

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: East Kingston hillside community.

communities.name: Kingston
communities.note: Jamaica's capital city.

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Major Kingston junction.

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston's business and entertainment hub.

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Kingston's busiest commercial hub — the clock tower is the landmark.

communities.name: Trench Town
communities.note: Birthplace of reggae — Bob Marley grew up here.

communities.name: Washington Gardens
communities.note: Kingston suburb along Spanish Town Road.

communities.name: Riverton
communities.note: On the western edge of Kingston.

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Jamaica's former colonial capital.

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: The gorge community where the Rio Cobre carves through limestone hills.

communities.name: Flat Bridge
communities.note: Historic single-lane bridge over the Rio Cobre, dates to the 1700s.

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Market town in St. Catherine — 'Carry Me Ackee Go a Linstead Market'.

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: St. Catherine community, home of the Alpart alumina plant.

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Hill-country junction between Kingston and Ocho Rios.

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Famous open-air cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival.

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: 2km natural tunnel of tree ferns — one of Jamaica's most scenic drives.

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: St. Ann's Bay resort town — Dunn's River Falls is the finale.
